currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful whole-building northeast/west photographs and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observations: Northeast exterior: tall green copper crossing spire, square stone belfry with paired rounded arcades, four conical corner turrets, green pitched choir/transept roofs, rounded lower chapel, pale gray-green stone, tall lancets/rose on north gable, and flat western tower in the distance. Trees obscure portions of the east end; exact roofs/thresholds remain approximate.

West screen: two flat square towers with narrow tall pointed belfry recesses and corner pinnacles, broad connecting wall with rows of carved niches, large central rose beneath a pointed gable, central taller nave gable and three lower portal bays. Simplify statue reliefs/tracery into selected faceted shapes; do not reconstruct individual figures or copy photo textures.
